messages:
dana: Console pages hanging again when users click "Estimate recompute" for big windows ( >12h ). Spikes in estimate API and then the UI polling never resolves. Seeing 503s from gateway. anyone seen this pattern?

ryan: saw alerts. gateway shows upstream 502/503 for /v1/recompute/preview-estimate, p99 latency jumping from 120ms -> 12s. backlog of pending estimate jobs.

priya: I traced it to the cardinality scan step in the estimate worker. After the recent retention change the estimate touches many more partitions and sometimes does a full S3 list (costly).

chan: can we short-circuit the UI to use a cached cardinality if it's <24h since last run? also add a quick sampled estimate (0.5% sample) so UX isn't blocked.

infra-bot: rate-limit triggered: estimate_service token_bucket exhausted (burst=0/5) at 2026-03-21T11:02:10Z

ryan: proposals: 1) add `X-Estimate-Mode: async|sync|sample` header so console can request `sample` by default for large windows; 2) return 202 + status_url when `async` and process in low-priority lane; 3) implement a circuit-breaker that returns a lightweight approximation under high load.

priya: +1 on sample & async. also we need a quota token per-org for concurrent estimate jobs so one tenant doesn't DoS the estimate pool. keep default concurrent_estimates=2.

chan: UX idea: show a tiny badge "Sampled estimate" and a link "Run full estimate (may take minutes)" which calls the async flow. That way PMs know what's happening.

dana: ops, can you pause any manual backfills that are hammering the estimate service? I see two long-running admin replays started in the last hour.

ops-bot: backfill-549 paused by ops at 11:05 UTC. backfill-551 remains running (tenant=acme-int).

ryan: quick mitigation: add debounce on the console so repeated estimate clicks are collapsed to 1 request per 5s per user. Also add client-side cache key: `estimate:v1:{tenant}:{window_hash}` TTL=60s.

priya: longer-term: change compute routing so `preview/sample` routes to a small-fast pool optimized for head scans (low mem, high IOPS), and `full/async` routes to primary heavy pool. We'll add metrics `estimate.mode` + `estimate.latency_by_mode`.

chan: small code snippet for console to use sample mode:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/recompute/estimate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Estimate-Mode: sample" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-03-19T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-20T00:00:00Z"}'
```

ryan: API change is backward compatible if header absent -> sync/full. We'll need eng-platform + API-gateway review for a header-based routing rule and to wire quota tokens.

dana: action items: ryan -> open PR for header/async 202+status_url behavior; priya -> create preview pool + routing flags; chan -> small UX change & debounce; ops-bot -> pause backfill-551 and reduce admin backfill concurrency to 1 while we roll this out. check back in 45m.

ops-bot: pausing backfill-551 now. state=paused.

priya: I'll also add a cheap approximate counter that uses HyperLogLog on a recent sample window to provide a fast-estimate scalar with `confidence: low|med|high` to show in the UI for sampled mode.

chan: perfect. let's surface the confidence label prominently so users don't mistake sample numbers for exact costs.

dana: thanks all. once PRs land let's run a canary that enables sample-by-default for tenants with >100M events to ensure no regression.

ryan: opened PR #4132 (refs this thread). tagging @priya @chan.

priya: started preview pool infra. adding metrics + alerts for `estimate.mode=full p99>2s`.

dana: dashboards responsive again after ops pause. we'll monitor and reconvene if alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
